xwalk_note: OF 7196 unit O: Organic deposits: peat and muck up to 2 m thick; bogs, depressions, poorly drained areas, valley bottoms; may contain ice-wedge polygons
OF 7196 unit C: Colluvial deposits: angular pebbles, cobbles to boulders, up to 10 m thick; talus from weathering and frost shattering of bedrock along escarpments
OF 7196 unit E: Eolian sediments: fine to medium sand, 1 m to at least 4 m thick; active and stabilized dunes and blow-outs; derived from glaciofluvial deposits
OF 7196 unit A: Alluvial sediments: silt to gravel, 1 m to at least 3 m thick; floodplains and alluvial fans of modern streams and rivers
OF 7196 unit L: Glaciolacustrine blanket and veneer: silt and sand, 1 to 3 m thick; temporary glacier-dammed lakes during deglaciation
OF 7196 unit D: Glaciolacustrine deltas: sand, gravel and cobbles, up to 5 m or more thick; temporary glacier-dammed lakes; kettles, braided paleochannels, ice-wedge polygons, beach ridges
OF 7196 unit G2: Outwash: sand and gravel, less than 3 m to at least 20 m thick; subaqueous deposits, subaerial fans and terraces
OF 7196 unit G1: Esker sediments: sand, gravel, cobbles and small boulders, 1 to at least 30 m thick; ridges up to 20 km long with flanking aprons
OF 7196 unit T3: Hummocky till: diamicton, compact, 3 m to at least 5 m thick; irregular to rolling terrain, low morainal ridges
OF 7196 unit T2: Till blanket: diamicton, moderately compact, 2 to 5 m thick; till plains and drumlinoid fields; may contain till veneer
OF 7196 unit T1: Till veneer: diamicton, less than 1-2 m thick, discontinuous, rock structure visible; lag on washed bedrock; small patches of bedrock
OF 7196 unit R: Bedrock: undifferentiated sedimentary, volcanic, plutonic and metamorphic rocks; patches of till veneer and glaciofluvial sediments; shattered rock and meltwater scour
